stories.title: La IA como salvavidas donde faltan médicos, profesores y asesores agrícolas

en.title: AI as a lifeline where doctors, teachers and agricultural advisors are lacking
en.summary: The Gates Foundation's annual Goalkeepers report promotes artificial intelligence to reduce inequalities in health, education and agriculture, announcing a 1 billion dollar investment to ensure benefits reach those most in need.

stories.title: Los Emmy de 2026 dan la sorpresa con el triunfo de ‘La maldición de Widow’s Bay’

en.title: 2026 Emmy Awards deliver surprise with triumph of 'The Curse of Widow's Bay'
en.summary: An Apple TV horror-comedy series won 14 of 19 Emmy Awards including best series, while medical drama 'The Pitt' and its lead actor Noah Wyle won in their categories, and Jean Smart received the best actress award for 'Hacks'.

stories.title: Los dueños de la IA quieren escribir sus propias reglas: “La gran pregunta es saber si está en peligro la humanidad o todo esto es una operación de marketing cínica”

en.title: AI owners want to write their own rules: "The big question is whether humanity is in danger or this is all cynical marketing"
en.summary: Companies that warn about artificial intelligence risks are seeking to play a decisive role in shaping the laws that would regulate them.

stories.title: Florista, tapicero o ebanista: las profesiones sin titulación universitaria son las menos expuestas a la IA

en.title: Florist, upholsterer or carpenter: professions without university degrees are least exposed to AI
en.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics published analysis showing which professions are most replaceable by artificial intelligence, with higher-skilled occupations facing greater risk.

stories.title: El Gobierno crea una vía preferente para aprobar inversiones estratégicas en un mes

en.title: The Government creates a fast-track route to approve strategic investments in one month
en.summary: The Spanish government has established an expedited approval process for strategic investments, with beneficiaries receiving priority access to electrical grid connections.

stories.title: La gasolina es más cara que el diésel por primera vez desde marzo

en.title: Gasoline is more expensive than diesel for the first time since March
en.summary: Gasoline prices have risen above diesel prices for the first time since March, while diesel price increases have slowed due to a safeguard mechanism that expanded tax relief exclusively to diesel in September.

stories.title: Alejandra supera tres malformaciones en el 12 de Octubre y sopla las velas de su cumpleaños por primera vez

en.title: Alejandra overcomes three malformations at 12 de Octubre Hospital and celebrates her birthday for the first time
en.summary: A four-year-old girl has successfully recovered from three congenital malformations affecting her airway after complex treatment at a Madrid public hospital, allowing her to celebrate her birthday for the first time.

stories.title: Detenida en Barajas una mujer embarazada que transportaba 69 bultos con cocaína en el interior de su cuerpo

en.title: A pregnant woman arrested at Barajas carrying 69 packages of cocaine inside her body
en.summary: A 20-year-old Brazilian woman was detained at Madrid's Barajas Airport while attempting to transport cocaine internally, having voluntarily admitted to working as a drug mule.

stories.title: El milagro de Alejandra: de no poder respirar a poder soplar las velas en su cuarto cumpleaños

en.title: Alejandra's miracle: from unable to breathe to blowing out candles on her fourth birthday
en.summary: A child born with airway malformations has recovered from a tracheotomy through treatment at a Madrid hospital and continues to regain functional abilities.

stories.title: Madrid levanta la suspensión del estadio del Rayo Vallecano y puede volver a funcionar

en.title: Madrid lifts suspension of Rayo Vallecano stadium and it can resume operations
en.summary: Madrid authorities have lifted the suspension of Rayo Vallecano's stadium following a new audit. The inspection confirmed that facilities are operational and suitable for normal functioning.

stories.title: La Comunidad de Madrid levanta la orden de suspensión del estadio de Vallecas al Rayo

en.title: Madrid Community lifts suspension order of Vallecas stadium from Rayo
en.summary: The Madrid regional government has temporarily lifted the suspension order for Rayo's stadium facility, though it maintains plans to terminate the concession. The team will return to play at home against Athletic on October 10.

stories.title: Detenida una embarazada en Barajas con 69 bellotas de cocaína ocultas en su cuerpo

en.title: Pregnant woman detained at Barajas with 69 cocaine pellets hidden in her body
en.summary: A pregnant woman was arrested at Madrid's airport after authorities discovered 69 packets of cocaine concealed on her person and was referred for judicial proceedings.

stories.title: Tecnológicas y bancos disparan la recompra de acciones

en.title: Tech companies and banks drive up stock buybacks
en.summary: Global share repurchases reached 572 billion dollars, jumping nearly 27 percent in the second quarter, with Salesforce, Apple, Toyota and Nvidia leading globally and BBVA topping Spanish companies.

stories.title: La Fed discute un alza de tipos y encara un choque frontal con Trump

en.title: The Fed discusses a rate hike and faces a head-on clash with Trump
en.summary: Markets expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates this Wednesday while the White House intensifies pressure for lower borrowing costs.

stories.title: Cómo entender la escalada de los bonos, con el de EEUU retando el 5%

en.title: How to understand the bond escalation, with the US one challenging 5%
en.summary: Investors are demanding higher returns on debt as they price in a prolonged period of elevated interest rates amid economic uncertainty.

stories.title: El gasto en bajas aumenta cuando baja el paro: ya absorbe el 10,4% de las cotizaciones

en.title: Spending on sick leave increases as unemployment falls: it already absorbs 10.4% of contributions
en.summary: Temporary disability benefit expenditures are rising even as unemployment declines, with spending growing by 6.5 billion euros between 2020 and 2025.

stories.title: EQT sella una alianza con Norges para pujar por Acciona Energía

en.title: EQT seals an alliance with Norges to bid for Acciona Energía
en.summary: Swedish venture capital firm EQT has partnered with Norway's sovereign wealth fund to compete for Acciona's renewable energy subsidiary being sold by the Entrecanales family.
